_comment: Shared literal fixture for the unified workout-duration gate.
Read by BOTH the Python locker (test_duration_threshold_fixture.py) and
Each language's own round-trip test cannot catch a drift between the two
sides -- only a shared literal like this one can. If you change the
threshold, change it here and watch both suites fail together.
advertised_minutes is the ONLY number that may appear in a user-facing
message. accept_minutes is deliberately invisible: a 35-minute session
passes while every string still says 40. Do not advertise accept_minutes.
